WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y.date, 4) = '2012' THEN y.consumption::numeric END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y.date, 4) = '2013' THEN y.consumption::numeric END) AS c2013
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON y.customerid = c.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND LEFT(y.date, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT segment,
         ROUND(((c2013 - c2012) / NULLIF(c2012, 0)) * 100, 2) AS increase_pct
  FROM seg
),
ext AS (
  SELECT MAX(increase_pct) AS max_pct, MIN(increase_pct) AS min_pct
  FROM pct
)
SELECT p.segment, p.increase_pct, 'highest' AS extreme
FROM pct p
CROSS JOIN ext e
WHERE p.increase_pct = e.max_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT p.segment, p.increase_pct, 'lowest' AS extreme
FROM pct p
CROSS JOIN ext e
WHERE p.increase_pct = e.min_pct
ORDER BY increase_pct DESC, segment

         translate(lower(a2), 'áäčďéěëíňóöřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeeinoorstuuuyz') AS name_key
  FROM district
  WHERE lower(a3) = 'central bohemia'
  ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC, translate(lower(a2), 'áäčďéěëíňóöřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeeinoorstuuuyz') ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(a16) AS avg_all FROM district
)
SELECT t.a2 AS district_name,
       t.a16 AS crimes_1996,
       ROUND(AVG(t.a16) OVER ()::numeric, 2) AS avg_top3_crimes_1996,
       ROUND(o.avg_all::numeric, 2) AS avg_all_crimes_1996,
       ROUND((AVG(t.a16) OVER () - o.avg_all)::numeric, 2) AS difference

SELECT p.sex,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.cnt, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_lab_dates
FROM patient AS p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS cnt
  FROM laboratory
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY id
) AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination e WHERE e.id = p.id)
GROUP BY p.sex
ORDER BY p.sex

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission = '-'

    SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.rf IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM examination e
    WHERE e.id = p.id
      AND (e.kct = '+' OR e.rvvt = '+' OR e.lac = '+')
  )

WITH d AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis, l.dna,
         CASE WHEN l.dna ~ '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$' THEN CAST(TRIM(l.dna) AS numeric) END AS v
  FROM patient AS p
  JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE p.diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT id, diagnosis, dna
FROM d
WHERE v IS NOT NULL
  AND v = (SELECT MAX(v) FROM d)
ORDER BY id

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT id, MAX("date") AS d
  FROM laboratory
  WHERE "date" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY id
),
pos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN latest t ON t.id = l.id AND t.d = l."date"
  WHERE CASE
          WHEN TRIM(l.rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(TRIM(l.rnp) AS numeric) >= 32
          ELSE FALSE
        END
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'M') AS integer) AS female_minus_male
FROM pos
JOIN patient p ON p.id = pos.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" <= DATE '1998-12-31' AND admission LIKE '+%'

FROM (

) AS sm
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'o'

) AS o ON o.molecule_id = sm.molecule_id

FROM (

  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
) AS t

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND lower(a.element) IN ('na','k','ca','cu','zn','sn','pb','mg','li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

WITH triple_elements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
    AND a.element IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN triple_elements AS t ON t.element = a.element
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC
